# ankra_cluster_mesh (Resource)

An organisation's Cilium ClusterMesh. Clusters join it with `ankra_cluster_mesh_member`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster mesh create` and `delete`. The platform deletes only an empty mesh, so remove its members first (Terraform does when the members reference the mesh).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_mesh" "edge" {
  name = "edge"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Mesh name. Changing it replaces the mesh.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the mesh.
- `slug` (String) Slug the platform derived from the name.
- `status` (String) Mesh status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Meshes are imported by id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_mesh.edge 9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d
```
